slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review states that DHIS2 implementation was announced by the Ministry of Health in 2019.

Data Landscapers' review states that on 2020-2021 assessments there was no evidence the DHIS2 rollout was complete or of facility-level digital recording, the national HMIS relying on aggregate data entry, likely from paper reports at district level.
Data Landscapers' review, citing the GHS Index, states that no electronic health records were in use, scored 0 in the 2020 assessment.

Data Landscapers' review states that rural primary healthcare clinics predominantly use paper for patient records, registers and prescriptions, with no 2024-2026 evidence of a shift to digital at rural level; no date is given for the statement, so the document's published date is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with World Bank health project support
systems.tiers: aggregate data entry, likely at district level from paper reports; tablets used for verification; no facility-level digital recording evidenced

note: The source is the author's AI-assisted compilation and flags itself as analysis, not sourced fact; its statements rest on the GHS Index 2021 and a World Bank health sector project document.
